name: Kaal Soulreaper
summary: In the Undercity, orc warlock Kaal Soulreaper trains apprentices and keeps close ties with practitioners of the dark arts across the Horde. Among the Forsaken, he guides students toward mentors in distant lands.

sections.title: A Practitioner in the Shadows
sections.body: Kaal Soulreaper works in the Undercity's Magic Quarter, where Horde warlocks come to learn from his mastery of demonic entities and curses. Thrall's Horde strictly regulates and monitors fel magic within Orgrimmar, while the subterranean sanctums of Lordaeron offer practitioners like Kaal ample harbor. Beyond teaching, Kaal connects those seeking greater power with mentors across the sea, including Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

faq.answer: Kaal Soulreaper trains warlocks in the Undercity's Magic Quarter. He teaches warlock spells and guides practitioners seeking specialized dark artifacts and rituals.

faq.q: Why is an orc warlock living in the Undercity?
aliases: why is an orc in undercity
faq.answer: Warlocks face heavy suspicion and scrutiny in orcish society under Warchief Thrall. The Undercity offers a more tolerant place to study shadow magic and demonology alongside the Forsaken.

faq.q: Where does Kaal Soulreaper send his apprentices?
aliases: who does kaal send you to
faq.answer: When his students reach sufficient mastery, Kaal sends them across the Great Sea to the Barrens to study under Menara Voidrender, or introduces them to other prominent Horde warlocks.

angles.text: As a warlock, you can learn demonic arts from Kaal Soulreaper, whose essential training sets ambitious warlocks on the paths to craft the Orb of Orahil and bind a Felsteed.
As an orc, you can find Kaal Soulreaper working openly in the Forsaken capital, away from Orgrimmar's watchful shamanic leadership and the hidden coven in the Cleft of Shadow.
